name: ecco
description: Shows which features each line of an ECCO checkout is traced to.

ecco.serverPath.description: The ecco-lsp launcher (lsp/build/install/ecco-lsp/bin/ecco-lsp after ./gradlew :ecco-lsp:installDist). Empty: the one built beside this extension in the repository, else ecco-lsp on the PATH.

ecco.javaHome.description: A Java 21 (or later) installation for the server. Empty: JAVA_HOME, or java on the PATH - which an editor started from the Dock or Finder may not have.
